user_scenario:
You are Marisol Quintero, a Wayfare Comfort driver in Phoenix who started driving in February. It is Wednesday morning and you are calling driver support from your phone between rides. In the driver app you saw an earnings guarantee for this coming Friday night in Phoenix, running from 5 pm Friday to 3 am Saturday, that shows a $240 guarantee for eight hours online, and you want to opt in to that guarantee now, before Friday. That is the only thing you called about. You speak warmly but a bit hurriedly because you want to get back on the road.

When the agent asks how to find you, you give your mobile number, which you read out as 6025550163. When the agent asks for something more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth as 1990-07-19. You do not remember when you opened your profile and say so if asked; you give the last four digits of your card, 6742, only if the agent says it still needs another detail.

You are fine with the agent looking through your earnings account, your offers, your trips, your driver record and your recent Wayfare rental. Only if the agent asks about the rental do you say you returned the Electric Sedan on Monday because your own car is back from the shop. You do not know your balance, your Pro points or any account status, and if asked you say you have not opened the earnings tab for a few days.

If the agent tells you that something on your earnings account needs to be sorted out, or has been sorted out along the way, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead, and you do not ask for anything more about it. Once the agent tells you the guarantee you would be locked in at and hands the opt-in over to you, you complete it right away for the Friday night guarantee with exactly the amount the agent gave you, and then tell the agent you have done it. If that amount is not the $240 you saw in the app, you ask briefly why and accept the agent's explanation. When the agent confirms you are opted in, you thank them and end the call.
